description: Put a real photograph on the canvas inside a box, the way a design tool does it: fit "cover" crops the picture to the box through a clipPath (the photo keeps its true proportions and stays repositionable, it is never squashed), fit "contain" fits it whole inside. corner_radius rounds the frame. scrim lays a transparent-to-colour gradient over the photo so overlay text stays readable on any image. Give it ONE source: data_url (base64 bytes you already have), url (a direct link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, which the server fetches and size-limits to 1.5 MB) or photo {query} (the server searches Unsplash, then Pexels, and the reply says which source and the attribution to credit). Coordinates are local to artboard when given. Returns the image, scrim and clip ids and the rendered box; one undo step. For a hero card with a title over the photo, prefer the photo_card component inside create_layout, which lays the caption out for you. Choose the photo with search_photos first (read docs guide photos); for a file the user supplied (a generated image, a logo) use upload_asset. Refused (drawn_only) in a project set to imagery "drawn": draw the picture instead.

data_url.description: data:image/png|jpeg|webp|gif;base64,... Use this only for bytes you already hold; prefer url or photo.

index.description: Which search result to use, default 0. Use search_photos first when the subject matters.

query.description: What the photo should show, e.g. "mountain trail forest".

source.description: Force one source. Default: Unsplash, then Pexels.

color.description: CSS colour of the wash, default #000000.

direction.description: Which edge the wash darkens toward. Default bottom, for a caption at the foot of a hero.

opacity.description: Opacity at the strong end, default 0.62.

start.description: Where the wash begins, 0 to just under 1. Default 0.4, so the top of the photo stays clean.

scrim.description: true for the default bottom wash, or an object. Use it under any text placed over the photo.

url.description: Direct link to an image file. The server fetches it; the editor cannot fetch across origins.
